explanation: The Olympic distance is a 1.5 km swim, a 40 km ride and a 10 km run. Triathlon joined the Olympic programme at Sydney in 2000.

claims.text: A standard triathlon is raced in the order swim, cycle, run.
Standard triathlons are not raced in the orders run, cycle, swim; cycle, swim, run; or swim, run, cycle.
The Olympic-distance triathlon is a 1.5 km swim, a 40 km cycle and a 10 km run.
Triathlon was first held at the Olympics at Sydney 2000.
